components.html:
Experience

#experience

Roles at Lumen Technologies with production scale and modernization work.

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a well-set Unix man page translated into a modern portfolio: a sticky running header with a `VIRUCHITH` wordmark, hanging-indent sections, a synopsis that states usage before prose, and an articles list placed with the primary evidence. Article pages still close with a See also list. Proportional Schibsted Grotesk carries display and reading; JetBrains Mono is reserved for code, dates, figures, identifiers, and the wordmark. Light and dark are first-class peers—each theme is tuned independently and remembered—rather than a dark-only skin.

Personality is precise, dense, and evidence-led. Structure comes from hairline rules and a 12-column hanging grid, not from cards or panels. Interaction grammar is inversion: ink and paper swap for hover, selected, pressed, and current states. Depth is overlap and tone, never shadow. Rejected directions: the prior Lit Control Room (Inter/Manrope, cyan glow, pill CTAs, glass panels), decorative gradients, inset hero imagery, and marketing card grids.
keyCharacteristics: Dual light/dark paper–ink system with one blue accent for underlines, focus, and washes.
Schibsted Grotesk for UI and prose; JetBrains Mono for identifiers, dates, figures, and the man-page wordmark.
Squared 2px corners everywhere; no pills, no soft card radii.
Hanging-indent sections (3/9 on md+) joined by full-width hairline rules.
Signature interaction: cross-reference trail—claim links invert on hover/focus and name their target in the running header.

rules.name: The Paper–Ink Rule
rules.body: Light and dark are paired themes that flip the same roles. Never invent a third surface ladder or a dark-only accent language.

rules.name: The Accent Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Accent marks underlines, focus, and washes only. Primary actions use ink fills, not accent fills.

rules.name: The Mono Discipline Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for identifiers and evidence—wordmark, dates, figures, code, anchors—not for marketing eyebrows or uppercase tracking strips.

rules.name: The Semibold Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Headings top out at weight 600. Do not reintroduce 700–800 display posters from the prior world.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Never add drop shadows, glow, or backdrop blur. If a surface needs separation, use a rule or step to raised.

rules.name: The 2px Rule
rules.body: If a control needs a corner, it is 2px. Do not introduce full-round or soft-card radii.

dos: Do keep light and dark as paired paper–ink themes with independent accent values.
Do use Schibsted Grotesk for reading and JetBrains Mono only for identifiers, dates, figures, code, and the wordmark.
Do structure pages with hanging-indent grids and hairline rules, not cards.
Do invert ink/paper for hover, selected, pressed, and current states.
Do reserve accent for underlines, focus rings, carets, and washes.
Do keep corners at 2px and the article measure at 56ch (about 70 characters).
donts: Don't revive Lit Control Room tokens (cyan glow, indigo panels, Inter/Manrope, pill CTAs, glass cards).
Don't add shadows, glows, gradients, or backdrop blur.
Don't fill primary buttons with accent blue—ink is the action color.
Don't introduce uppercase tracked eyebrows or marketing kickers; row labels stay man-page meta.
Don't put body copy in monospace or display weight above 600.
Don't wrap evidence lists in elevated card chrome.
